# Arshdeep Yadav — Portfolio & AI Lab

> AI/ML Engineer, AI Product Builder, and IIT Patna MBA (Generative AI & Product Management) candidate. Author of published IEEE RMKMATE 2026 research on Explainable Vision Transformers for Satellite Image Analysis.

## Selected Projects & Research

- [Explainable Vision Transformer (XViT)](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11518743): Published IEEE paper on transformer-aligned explanation maps for remote sensing.
- [Satellite ViT XAI Repository](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav/satellite-vit-xai): Open source PyTorch implementation of Attention Rollout and Grad-CAM patch saliency for SEN12MS.
- [Bluestock Fintech IPO Tracking Platform](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav): Live market telemetry tracking $18.2M+ in 24h volume.
- [Plant Disease Classification](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav): 98.2% accuracy CNN model across 38 botanical pathology categories.
- [Real-Time Object Detection](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav): Edge-optimized YOLOv8 pipeline processing 45 FPS with 12ms latency.
- [Physiological Stress Detection](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav): 0.91 F1-score multi-class physiological stress classifier with SHAP interpretability.
- [Smart Embedded Assistive Hardware](https://github.com/Arshdeep-Yadav): Haptic feedback assistive walking stick and IoT alert telemetry.
